_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 12: 2025-01-01 to 2025-01-10, completing Q1 2025 and everything before it. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He describes building up additional language channels as part of the channel's growth to spread the gospel worldwide in 2025, with more to be added.
mentions.quote: spreading the gospel throughout the whole world in 2025
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: channel plans, though it is the Asian channels commission being executed.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a woman at an ice cream store telling him the shmita cycle is over, that it will be in September and that she is going home in September.
mentions.quote: it's going to be in September and I'm going home in September
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; someone else's dated rapture expectation that he reports.

mentions.claim_text: He refers back to a word given around Valentine's Day the previous February which he says changed him and shapes how he looks at things.
mentions.quote: it was in February it's about Valentine's Day that time frame
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the content of the word is not restated here.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that the plans of darkness will be foiled, says there is an anointing present and the Lord is there, and tells viewers to receive their miracles.
mentions.quote: plans will be foiled the darkness will be foiled yeah it's foiled time
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a foiled plan and no plan look the same.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in October he heard the devil petition the Lord, saying time is up and Adam's lease is up and that the seven year tribulation must now begin because it is his time.
mentions.quote: time is up Adam's lease is up and you must begin the this the seven-year
mentions.falsify_match: The tribulation beginning, which the four year reprieve is said to have deferred.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not begin, which the reprieve explains in advance.

mentions.claim_text: Looking out over America he saw a massive storm coming and the Antichrist spirit trying to come on America, but the Lord giving America a reprieve of a four year window, and he notes people saying they see past four years while he has only seen four.
mentions.quote: the Lord was giving America a reprieve for a 4-year window
mentions.falsify_match: The storm arriving at the close of the four years rather than inside them.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions five portals or doors that have not been opened in twenty five years, says it is not coincidence, and that dominoes are falling into place because Jesus is standing at the door.
mentions.quote: five portals we haven't opened up in 25 years
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: portals opening has no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He says believers will be prompted at the mall or the gas station to do something, signs will follow, and onlookers will ask what just happened.
mentions.quote: signs are going to follow you and they're going to go what just
mentions.falsify_match: Widely reported public miracles performed by ordinary believers.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that no demonic spirit takes out the president, holding the blood over inauguration day and over the certification on the 6th so that this time it goes smoothly rather than as it did last time.
mentions.quote: there will be no demonic spirit that takes out our President
mentions.falsify_match: Disruption of the certification or the inauguration.
mentions.falsify_miss: Both pass smoothly, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He prays a covering over the Capitol so there is no January 6 weirdness this time, and declares that the terrorist attacks he has seen trying to come are brought to justice and found in the vans.
mentions.quote: the terrorist attacks that I've seen trying to come we say you were brought
mentions.falsify_match: Vehicle-borne attacks intercepted in the US, which the New Orleans attack five days earlier makes concrete.

mentions.claim_text: He says the glorious church, the bride without spot or wrinkle, will rise in a mighty wave and that an outpouring of the Spirit is about to hit the planet in the next four years.
mentions.quote: it's going to take place in the next four years
mentions.falsify_match: A global outpouring inside the four year window.

mentions.claim_text: Opening of his first live video, checking whether viewers can see and hear them.
mentions.quote: I'm not used to doing live vide so it's a it's h very strange
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: Responding to the New Orleans attack in the last twenty four hours he says he feels they failed and grieves, not knowing where those people stood with the Lord.
mentions.quote: last 24 hours I feel we failed I I grieve
mentions.condition_text: the failure is framed as a failure of intercession
mentions.falsify_match: Rare and worth recording: an attack he had warned about happened and he treats it as a loss rather than a hit.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers to ask the Lord daily which events and places to go to, because the days are going to get very dark.
mentions.quote: the days are going to get very dark I told you
mentions.condition_text: safety conditioned on asking and listening about where to go
mentions.falsify_match: A period widely described as very dark.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such period, though no date is given.

mentions.claim_text: He refers to a visitation on 26 December, his wife's birthday, in which he saw people holding catcher's mitts, as in baseball, and that they would be the ones catching what is thrown.
mentions.quote: people had uh catcher mitts in their hands it's like baseball
mentions.falsify_match: A harvest large enough to need catching, as in bigger-net-harvest.

mentions.claim_text: He says places like Las Vegas have an open door through sin, and that when you open the door the devil comes in to kill, steal and destroy as a roaring lion.
mentions.quote: places that have an open door through sin there's a lot of sin down there
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an explanation of why attacks land where they do, offered after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He says the threat comes not from the southern border but the northern, that he saw people in Toronto and the Lord showed him cells of people there coming across from the northeast.
mentions.quote: these cells of people were in Toronto and they were coming across
mentions.falsify_match: A terror cell entering the US from Canada via the northeast.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer going into 2025 with anticipation of great demonstrations of glory, calling it a year of great victory in which the seers and the harvesters go hand in hand.
mentions.quote: the seers and the Harvesters will go hand in hand in 2025
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He says they believe in this household that they will not taste death on this side of the earth because Jesus is coming soon and they are that generation, tying it to the one last call from his visitation.
mentions.quote: we won't taste death on this side of the Earth because Jesus is coming
mentions.falsify_match: The rapture occurring within his household's lifetime.
mentions.falsify_miss: Members of the household dying first, which would settle it.

mentions.claim_text: He declares for viewers that in 2025 they are debt free with a paid off house and car, promoted at work, and giving enough to promote the gospel worldwide.
mentions.quote: I believe in 2025 I'm debt free I have a house that's paid for
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private financial outcomes over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: Opening on New Year's Eve, he says he has been interceding intensely over the coming year for several days.
mentions.quote: I've been interceding for this uh New Year all the last several days
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a celebration for the bride and the groom, a uniting, and says he was told all of this will start taking place with a great acceleration of change, and that 2025 will be a year of great change.
mentions.quote: 2025 will be a year of great great change
mentions.falsify_match: 2025 marked by change on a scale people notice.

mentions.claim_text: Citing the promise to Abraham of blessing to a thousand generations, he says the Lord told him he is going to really show up and show off, and that they will see it.
mentions.quote: I'm going to really show up and show off now you're going to see that
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for God showing off.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a dividing line in the sand and a great shaking in the body of Christ across 2025, 2026, 2027 and 2028, and that in this window he will awaken his church and there will be a major harvest of souls.
mentions.quote: a great shaking in the body of Christ in 2025 2026 2027 2028
mentions.falsify_match: A visible split and upheaval across the church through to 2028, with a mass harvest.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such shaking or harvest by the end of 2028.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the catchers missing as people who were asleep began to wake, that they were catching and bringing them in, and that Jesus is standing at the door.
mentions.quote: I saw the the catchers Miss and we were catching and bringing those people in
mentions.falsify_match: An influx of converts outpacing the churches' capacity to receive them.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers to write on a board what they are believing for along with the scriptures that pertain to it, resting on the promise that those who abide and whose words remain may ask what they will.
mentions.quote: find scriptures and write those on there too
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on abiding and on his words remaining
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: practice with a condition.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that in 2025 they will thrive, while noting he does not want to use Christian lingo all the time the way people said 2024 we will soar, but that the Lord did say it.
mentions.quote: in 2025 we will Thrive
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and he half concedes it: the rhyming year-word is a genre he is aware of.

mentions.claim_text: Healing prayer over disease and over mental torment, disorders of the mind, depression, anxiety, fear, worry and PTSD, declaring 2025 a great year.
mentions.quote: no depression anxiety fear worry whatever it may be what is that called PTSD
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: conditions common enough that any large audience supplies matches.

mentions.claim_text: He calls back double from the thief for everything stolen in 2024 and declares a restitution of peace, joy and all of it in 2025.
mentions.quote: you will give us back double everything you stole
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private restitution over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: Sign off asking viewers to like, subscribe and hit the bell, thanking them for 2024 and looking to a greater 2025.
mentions.quote: we look forward to a greater year with yall in 2025
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sign off.
